description: Unified card pool for Clank! Catacombs custom deck builder. Includes Catacombs base, Adventure pack, and tentative Lairs/Underworld cards pending physical verification.

cards.name: Empurror
cards.text:
Chose one (or all three, if you have an artifact):
-2 Clank! -OR- $1 -OR- You don't have to stop in Crystal Caves this turn.

cards.name: Golden Flute
cards.text:
$1, +1 Clank!
You may buy one item from the Market this turn for $5 (even if you're not in a Market room).

cards.name: Payoff
cards.text: Trash this card.

cards.name: Rebel Scribe
cards.text: If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card.

cards.name: Waystone
cards.text: You may trash this to teleport from one Wayshrine to another.

cards.name: Flamboyance
cards.text:
Draw a card.
If you make 2 or more Clank! this turn, +2 Skill.

cards.name: Imp Familiar
cards.text: Take a lockpick -OR- Spend a lockpick to draw two cards.

cards.name: Pillage
cards.text: If you gain at least $3 this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Remove Traps
cards.text:
Replace a card in the dungeon row.
(If the new card has a dragon attack symbol, ignore it.)

cards.name: Shadow Walk
cards.text: Trash a Burgle in your play area or discard pile.

cards.name: Astral Projection
cards.text: If you generate 6 Skill or more this turn, mark a Wayshrine (as though you were there).

cards.name: Boots of the Ape Lord
cards.text:
+3 Clank!
If you have a monkey idol, you don't have to stop in Crystal Caves this turn.

cards.name: Bard
cards.text:
+1 Clank!
If you make 2 or more Clank! this turn, ♥♥.

cards.name: Lie in Wait
cards.text: If you're in a Crystal Cave, -2 Clank!
cards.acquire: You may put this on top of your deck.

cards.name: Lightstick
cards.text: +1 Clank!

cards.name: Rebel Thief
cards.text:
Take a lockpick.
If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card.

cards.name: Riot
cards.text:
+1 Clank!
If you have freed three or more prisoners, you may trash a card in your play area or discard pile.

cards.name: Smash and Grab
cards.text:
+2 Clank!
Draw two cards.

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.text: -2 Clank!

cards.name: Sudden Movement
cards.arriveDanger: Each player alone on a square tile must rotate that tile to a new orientation.

cards.name: Charlatan
cards.text: Discard a card to draw two cards.

cards.name: Corrupt Advisor
cards.text:
Each other player gets +1 Clank!
If you have a crown, they get +2 Clank! instead.
cards.arriveDanger: DANGER Pull +1 cube for dragon attacks.

cards.name: Divining Rod
cards.text: If you generate 6 Skill or more this turn, ♥.

cards.name: Elven Sword
cards.text: Draw a card.

cards.name: Librarian
cards.text:
-2 Clank!
If you have a Secret Tome in your play area or discard pile, draw two cards.

cards.name: Rebel Paladin
cards.text:
If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card.
If you have an artifact, draw a card.

cards.name: Skulker
cards.text: Ignore monsters in tunnels this turn.
cards.acquire: Ignore monsters in tunnels this turn.

cards.name: Smoky Quartz
cards.text:
-2 Clank!
Draw a card.

cards.name: Spectral Rider
cards.text: If you're on a haunted tile, you may teleport to any room on a different haunted tile.

cards.name: White Tourmaline
cards.text:
Draw a card.
When a Ghost would damage you, you may discard this to prevent that and draw a card.

cards.name: Brave Hero
cards.text: Worth 5 VP if you have freed three or more Prisoners.

cards.name: Curator
cards.text: Draw a card for each artifact you have.

cards.name: Diversion
cards.arriveDanger: Put 3 dragon cubes back in the bag.

cards.name: Rebel General
cards.text: If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card.

cards.name: Robbery
cards.text:
$2
If you're in a Market room, teleport to an adjacent room.
cards.acquire: You may put this on top of your deck.

cards.name: Rose Quartz
cards.text:
-2 Clank!
Draw a card.

cards.name: Black Tourmaline
cards.text:
Draw a card.
When a Ghost would damage you, you may discard this to prevent that and draw a card.

cards.name: Crystal Compass
cards.text:
Draw two cards.
You don't have to stop in Crystal Caves this turn.

cards.name: Double Cross
cards.text: -2 Clank!

cards.name: Expensive Taste
cards.text:
$2
Worth 5 VP if you have a crown and a gem.

cards.name: Fiery Quartz
cards.text:
-2 Clank!
Draw a card.

cards.name: Floating Skull
cards.text: If you have a crown, teleport to an adjacent room.

cards.name: Grand Theft
cards.text: Take a lockpick —OR— Spend a lockpick yo use a device or acquire a card in the dungeon row.
cards.acquire: You may put this on top of your deck.

cards.name: Lute
cards.text:
+1 Clank!
Draw two cards.
For each Clank! you make this turn, $1.

cards.name: Souldrinker
cards.text: If you defeat a monster in the dungeon row this turn, ♥.

cards.name: Thirst for Adventure
cards.text: Worth 2 VP for each artifact and each mokey idol you have.

cards.name: Blink Spell
cards.text: Teleport to an adjacent room -OR- Teleport to another player in the Depths.

cards.name: Wishing Well
cards.text:
You must spend $3 to use.
USE:
Draw two cards.
cards.arriveDanger: DANGER Pull +1 cube for dragon attacks.

cards.name: Darkened Alcove
cards.text:
USE:
-2 Clank!

cards.name: Underground River
cards.text:
USE:
♥ or Boot

cards.name: Locked Trunk
cards.text:
You must spend a lockpick to use.
USE:
Take a major secret.

cards.name: Thieves' Shrine
cards.text:
USE:
$2 -OR- Trash up to two Burgles, each from your play area or discard pile.
cards.arriveDanger: Put 3 dragon cubes back in the bag.

cards.name: Black Market
cards.text:
USE:
Choose TWO:
$2 -OR- Trash a card in your play area or discard pile -OR- Take a lockpick.

cards.name: Skeleton
cards.text: DEFEAT: $2, +1 Clank!

cards.name: Animated Wall
cards.text:
DEFEAT: 1 Boot
If you use a portal this turn, +1 Boot.
cards.arriveDanger: Rotate each square tile with any players on it 180 degrees.

cards.name: Crystal Kobold
cards.text:
Fight this only in a Crystal Cave or Wayshrine.
DEFEAT: 2 Skill

cards.name: Keymaster
cards.text: DEFEAT: Take a Lockpick

cards.name: Skeleton Priest
cards.text: DEFEAT: ♥, +1 Clank!
cards.arriveDanger: All players get +1 Clank!

cards.name: Archoverlord
cards.text: DEFEAT: Draw two cards, each other player gets +1 Clank!
cards.arriveDanger: All players get +1 Clank!

cards.name: Marble Guardian
cards.text:
DEFEAT: Place a new tile next to your current one. Choose:
Teleport to any room on the new tile -OR- $2

cards.name: Skeletal Ape
cards.text: DEFEAT: $3, 3 Skill, +3 Clank!

cards.name: Skeleton Warlock
cards.text: DEFEAT: Take a Secret Tome, +1 Clank!

cards.name: The Warden
cards.text:
Deep (Fight only in the Depths.)
DEFEAT: Free two Prisoners
cards.arriveDanger: DANGER Pull +1 cube for dragon attacks.

cards.name: Ogre Merchant
cards.text: DEFEAT: $5 -OR- If you're in a Market room, take a Market item (at no cost).

cards.name: Cutpurse
cards.text: REACT: An opponent enters a market room. [Lockpick] -OR- 2 coin. You may discard a card to get both.
cards.flavor: Watch your money in the market.

cards.name: Spiritual Healer
cards.text: If you have a Gem in your play area or discard pile, heart and +1 Clank!
cards.arriveDanger: You may make +2 Clank! to heart (heal 1).
cards.flavor: If you doubt the crystal is necessary, just wait for the loud chanting.

cards.name: Virtuoso Burglar
cards.text: -2 Clank! Trash a Burgle in your play area or discard pile.
cards.arriveDanger: You may make +1 Clank! to trash a Burgle from your hand or discard pile.
cards.flavor: Want it done right? Call her.

cards.name: Rebel Herald
cards.text: If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card.
cards.flavor: The most enduring friendships begin with a proper introduction.

cards.name: Tactician
cards.text: You can't really disrupt his plan. He'll just devise a new one.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.text: For each Clank! you make this turn, 1 coin.
cards.flavor: The screaming is a plus, you see. It draws more enemies to the fight.

cards.name: Assassin
cards.text: -2 Clank!
cards.flavor: Her clientele consists mostly of dungeon delvers and politicians.

cards.name: Royal Brat
cards.text: If you have a crown, take a minor secret.
cards.flavor: It's mine! I want it now!

cards.name: Flawed Ruby
cards.text: Draw a card.
cards.acquire: +2 Clank!, each other player gets +1 Clank!

cards.name: Flawed Sapphire
cards.text: Draw a card.
cards.acquire: +2 Clank!, each other player gets +1 Clank!

cards.name: Flawed Emerald
cards.text: Draw a card.
cards.acquire: +2 Clank!, each other player gets +1 Clank!

cards.name: Scouting Ahead
cards.text: You don't have to stop in Crystal Caves this turn.
cards.flavor: Stay here. Catch your breath. I'll see what's in the next passage.

cards.name: Too Bad for You
cards.text: (no main effect — just stats)
cards.flavor: Maybe the next time you try that, you should limber up first.

cards.name: One With Everything
cards.text: (no main effect — stats only)
cards.flavor: Open your mind to little opportunities and they'll add up to a big windfall.

cards.name: Time Warp
cards.text: Teleport to an adjacent room.
cards.flavor: This form of magical travel begins with a jump to the left.

cards.name: Walk It Off
cards.text: (no main effect — stats only)
cards.flavor: 'Tis but a scratch. I've had worse.

cards.name: Elven Satchel
cards.text: USE: Draw a card.
cards.arriveDanger: 1 coin -OR- +1 Clank!, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Great for carrying a travel cloak, dagger, and spare boots.

cards.name: Hiding Place
cards.text: USE: -2 Clank!
cards.arriveDanger: You may discard a Burgle to get -2 Clank!
cards.flavor: It's camouflage AND a weapons cache!

cards.name: Secret Passage
cards.text: USE: -2 Clank!, [Lockpick] [Lockpick]
cards.arriveDanger: You may spend 5 coin to acquire a Secret Tome.
cards.flavor: Never judge a bookcase by what it covers.

cards.name: Pixie Swarm
cards.text: DEFEAT: 1 coin
cards.arriveDanger: Each player who reveals a [Burgle] from their hand gets 1 coin.
cards.flavor: Nobody invades our territory. Let's get 'em!

cards.name: Spotter
cards.text: DEFEAT: Each player may make +1 Clank! to get 2 coin. You also get -2 Clank!
cards.arriveDanger: Pull +1 cube for dragon attacks.
cards.flavor: Even a dragon with six heads can use extra eyes in his dungeon.

cards.name: Leprechaun
cards.text: DEFEAT: 2 coin +1 Clank! -OR- 5 coin +3 Clank!
cards.arriveDanger: 2 coin +1 Clank! -OR- 5 coin +3 Clank! (Arrive Choice)
cards.flavor: Not especially tough, but they do hiss loudly when you get near.

cards.name: Scuffler
cards.text: DEFEAT: Each opponent chooses: -2 Clank! -OR- 2 coin -OR- Trash a Burgle in your discard pile. You get all three.
cards.flavor: Don't waste a good weapon battling a scuffler.

cards.name: Succubus
cards.text: DEFEAT: Each opponent chooses: 3 coin -OR- heart. You get both.
cards.flavor: Even if you don't see the allure, you'll reap the rewards.

cards.name: Ape Lord Phantasm
cards.text: DEFEAT: Draw two cards. Players may return any monkey idols to the monkey shrine room to take a Secret Tome for each.
cards.flavor: Some treasure isn't worth the nightmare that follows.

cards.name: Tinkerer
cards.text: Each device you use this turn costs 2 less.
cards.flavor: If she can't build a gadget to help with your task, your task might not be worth doing.

cards.name: Devotion
cards.text: Worth 1 skill for each cube you have in the dungeon.
cards.flavor: Sometimes called Crandlemuck, he is the god of thieves, wayshrines, and quality cloaks.

cards.name: Jailbreaker
cards.text: If you have freed any prisoners this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavor: On doors, it works just as well as a key. On jailers, it works much better.

cards.name: Monkey Paw
cards.text: +1 Clank! If you have a monkey idol, you may trash a card in your play area or discard pile.
cards.flavor: Go ahead. Make a wish!

cards.name: Quick Pick
cards.text: If you spent a lockpick this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Work smarter, not harder.

cards.name: Ten-Foot Pole
cards.text: Draw a card. The next time you reveal a tile this turn, you may put that tile beneath the stack to reveal another.
cards.flavor: What would you touch THIS with?

cards.name: Thirst for Knowledge
cards.text: +1 Clank! Worth 1 skill for each Secret Tome you have.
cards.flavor: Good reading light is so rare inside a dungeon that you really must take advantage when the opportunity arises.

cards.name: Tome of Fire
cards.text: This counts as a Secret Tome.
cards.flavor: It's a tough read.

cards.name: Amethyst
cards.text: -2 Clank! Draw a card.

cards.name: Cave Bat Wings
cards.text: TROPHY: While you have a Secret Tome in your play area or discard pile, you don't have to stop in Crystal Caves. Worth 4 if you have a mastery token.

cards.name: False Bottom
cards.text: USE: Take a lockpick. If you're in a Pit Trap room, +3 gold.
cards.flavor: Mostly you hit true bottoms. But occasionally...

cards.name: Merchant's Guild Pin
cards.text: TROPHY: Each Market item you buy costs 1 less.
cards.flavor: Most people steal these pins, because after the membership dues, it isn't really a deal.

cards.name: Cavern Prowler
cards.text: DEFEAT: Acquire a card from the dungeon row.
cards.flavor: Always on the top ten list of deadly subterranean cats.

cards.name: Hoard Keeper
cards.text: DEFEAT: 3 gold, +1 Clank! TROPHY: Worth 1 for every 5 gold you have.
cards.flavor: If you don't watch over your hoard, soon it won't BE a hoard.

cards.name: Jailer
cards.text: DEFEAT: Take a lockpick, free a Prisoner.
cards.arriveDanger: DANGER: Pull +1 cube for dragon attacks.
cards.flavor: The inmates call him "bird brain." Not to his face, of course.

cards.name: Pit Fiend
cards.text: DEFEAT: +2 gold, +1 Clank!, if you're in a Pit Trap room, free a prisoner.
cards.flavor: The bigger the hole, the bigger the creature who calls it home.

cards.name: Skeleton Troubadour
cards.text: DEFEAT: Take a minor secret, +1 Clank!
cards.flavor: It also provides its own percussion.

cards.name: Abyssal Hydra
cards.text: DEFEAT: Draw two cards, take 2 gold from this. This stays in the dungeon row if it still has any gold.
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: Put 6 gold on this.
cards.flavor: That is one hale hydra.

cards.name: Chimera
cards.text: DEFEAT: Take a major secret, +1 Clank!
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: All players get +1 Clank!
cards.flavor: There seems to have been some kind of mix-up.

cards.name: Cyclops
cards.text: DEFEAT: Take a lockpick, trash a card in your play area or discard pile.
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: All players get +1 Clank!
cards.flavor: Don't worry about the boulder. He doesn't have good depth perception.

cards.name: Grave Robber
cards.text: DEFEAT: +1 gold
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: Rotate each square tile with any players on it 180 degrees.
cards.flavor: In the Underworld lies grave danger.

cards.name: Harpy Matriarch
cards.text: Fight this only in the Underworld. DEFEAT: 2 (trophy). TROPHY: Worth 1 VP for each harpy trophy you have (including this one).
cards.flavor: Mess with her brood, and you're messing with her.

cards.name: Shifting Shadow
cards.text: DEFEAT: You may move in the wrong direction through one-way tunnels this turn.
cards.flavor: Invisible to most, these creatures dwell on the edge of the living world and the ghost world.

cards.name: Wild Boar
cards.text: DEFEAT: +1 Clank!, draw two cards.
cards.arriveDanger: DANGER: Pull +1 cube for dragon attacks.
cards.flavor: Best not stand in its path...

cards.name: Catapult
cards.text: USE: +2 Clank!, teleport to an adjacent room.
cards.flavor: "I have an idea. Hold my tankard."

cards.name: Moneychanger's Booth
cards.text: USE: Spend 2 skill. Trinkets from the upper world for access to the underworld.
cards.flavor: It's a great deal.

cards.name: Mystic Elevator
cards.text: USE: +1 Clank!, teleport to a Market room in the Underworld.
cards.flavor: "Going down?"

cards.name: Underground Spring
cards.text: USE: Heal. If you're in the Underworld, trash a card in your play area or discard pile.
cards.flavor: It's like drinking from the Fountain of Youth.

cards.name: Apprentice Thief
cards.flavor: No blacksmith or miller openings this year, unfortunately.

cards.name: George
cards.text: +1 Clank! and draw a card. If you have a monkey idol, do that again.
cards.flavor: If you make him furious, his response will be injurious.

cards.name: Gray Knight
cards.flavor: The core doctrine of the order of gray knights is moral flexibility.

cards.name: Hero of Prophecy
cards.text: If you have a fate card, trash a card in your play area or discard pile.
cards.flavor: "Did I choose this path? Or did the path choose me?"

cards.name: Oracle
cards.text: Draw a card. -OR- Spend 1 skill to draw two cards.
cards.flavor: Tips make the visions a little clearer.

cards.name: Orpheus
cards.text: +1 Clank!, +1 skill. Worth 1 VP for each freed Prisoner you have.
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: Put 3 dragon cubes back in the bag.

cards.name: Rebel Rouser
cards.text: If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card. If you make 2 or more Clank! this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavor: He always knows just what to say... assuming you want an angry mob.

cards.name: Rebel Tunnel Guide
cards.text: If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Tunnel Guiding has definitely gotten more dangerous over the years.

cards.name: Sculptor
cards.text: Trash a card in your play area. -OR- Draw a card.
cards.flavor: "Have you seen my brother, Clay?"

cards.name: Soothsayer
cards.text: If you have a fate card, +1 skill.
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: Each player may spend 1 gold to heal.
cards.flavor: "The future is coming soon."

cards.name: Spellblade Invoker
cards.text: +1 Clank! Teleport to an adjacent room.
cards.flavor: "I come from a long line of Invokers."

cards.name: Underworld Dealer
cards.text: +1 skill -OR- Spend 3 gold to take a Secret Tome.
cards.flavor: "You look very familiar." "Oh, my brother deals in rare items too!"

cards.name: Underworld Guide
cards.text: If you're in the Underworld, draw a card. When you trash this, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Ask him no questions... but you'd best read the fine print.

cards.name: Acid Splash
cards.text: Reveal the top card of your deck. (Reshuffle if needed.) Then choose: Trash it -OR- discard it to get 2 swords.
cards.flavor: This is a highly volatile spell.

cards.name: Big Ideas
cards.text: +1 Clank! If you generate 6 skill or more this turn, +1 gold.
cards.flavor: It's dumb enough that it might be brilliant.

cards.name: Escape Plan
cards.text: When you trash this, +2 boots and you don't have to stop in Crystal Caves this turn.
cards.flavor: Always know the way out.

cards.name: Ethereal Step
cards.text: If you generate 6 skill or more this turn, teleport to an adjacent room.
cards.flavor: They won't see you coming.

cards.name: Fire Breath
cards.text: If you make any Clank! this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Mages everywhere are chatting about this hot new spell.

cards.name: Quick Trip
cards.text: If you have an artifact worth 10 or less, you don't have to stop in Crystal Caves this turn.
cards.flavor: "Going in for some goodies. Need anything?"

cards.name: Slink
cards.text: -2 Clank! Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Alone or in pairs, this move is a wonderful ploy.

cards.name: Wealth of Knowledge
cards.text: Worth 1 VP for each Secret Tome you have.
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: All players get +1 gold.
cards.flavor: Unlock the riches of your mind.

cards.name: Burial Urn
cards.text: When you trash this, +4 skill.
cards.flavor: Its exterior is just as precious as its contents.

cards.name: Lantern
cards.text: Heal.
cards.flavor: The Underworld is a dark and dangerous place. You'll need something to light the way.

cards.name: Soul Prism
cards.text: When you trash this, free a prisoner.
cards.flavor: If you listen closely, you can hear tiny hands knocking.

cards.name: Thunderstriker
cards.text: Draw a card. Worth 1 VP for each harpy trophy you have.
cards.flavor: This sword is for the birds.

cards.name: Tome of Intellect
cards.text: Draw two cards. This counts as a Secret Tome.
cards.flavor: It's an exciting read. The words jump off the page.

cards.name: Tome of the Ape Lords
cards.text: If you have a monkey idol, this counts as a Secret Tome.
cards.flavor: Ape Lord magic was divided into three schools.

cards.name: Utility Knife
cards.text: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: It slices, it dices, it transfers wealth... but wait, there's more!

cards.name: Garnet
cards.text: 1 skill. Draw a card.

cards.name: Polished Garnet
cards.text: 1 skill. Draw a card.

cards.name: Underworld Guardian
cards.text: When encountered, you must defeat this or take 2 damage. DEFEAT: Take the 2x artifact enhancer. TROPHY: Bonus artifact. (Doesn't count for your artifact limit.)

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.text: Reveal on a future turn. When revealed, you don't have to stop in Crystal Caves this turn.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.text: Worth 10 if you have two Stumbles.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.text: Worth 6 if you have a Crown.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.text: At the end of the game, this counts as a Secret Tome.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.text: Reveal this immediately. Gain 2 hearts (heal 2).

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.text: Worth 12 if you have an artifact enhancer, a crown, and a monkey idol.
cards.vpCondition: if you have an artifact enhancer, a crown, and a monkey idol

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.text: Reveal this immediately. Gain 1 boot each turn.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.text: Reveal on a future turn to teleport to an adjacent room.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.text: Worth 10 if you have 10 gold or more.
cards.vpCondition: if you have 10 gold or more

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: If you have... 1 harpy trophy: 3, 2 harpy trophies: 5, 3+ harpy trophies: 8.

cards.name: Justice
cards.text: Reveal anytime. Allows you to carry an additional artifact.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.text: Worth 6 if you have a monkey idol.
cards.vpCondition: if you have a monkey idol

cards.name: Temperance
cards.text: Worth 4 victory points (flat value).

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.text: Reveal this immediately. Add a ghost cube from the supply to the Clank! area.

cards.name: The Imp
cards.text: If you have... 1 gem: 4, 2 gems: 8, 3+ gems: 12.

cards.name: Death
cards.text: If you have an artifact, score your points even if you were knocked out in the Depths. Worth 1, or -5 if you were knocked out in the Depths.
cards.vpCondition: 1 normally, -5 if knocked out in the Depths

cards.name: The Moon
cards.text: Worth 8 if you have two or more Underworld market items.
cards.vpCondition: if you have two or more Underworld market items

cards.name: The Tower
cards.text: You may reveal this if you're in a tower room to gain 3 gold.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.text: Worth 10 if you have a mastery token.
cards.vpCondition: if you have a mastery token

cards.name: The Star
cards.text: You may reveal this when one or more of your cubes are drawn from the bag. Return those cubes to your supply instead of taking damage.

cards.name: The World
cards.text: Worth 7 if you have three or more market items.
cards.vpCondition: if you have three or more market items

cards.name: Judgement
cards.text: Reveal this immediately. The dragon attacks.

cards.name: Candelabra
cards.text: If you have three or more cubes in the dungeon, Heal.
cards.flavor: A boon in the darkness, it will light up your life force.

cards.name: Artifact Detector
cards.text: The next time you reveal a tile this turn, if you don't have an artifact, you may put that tile beneath the stack to reveal another.
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: Return the lowest-value artifact from the dungeon to the artifact stack.

cards.name: Unlock Potential
cards.text: Draw a card -OR- Trash one of your trophies to draw three cards.
cards.flavor: "Um... I think the oracle meant to look into your OWN heart to find what you seek."

cards.name: Swords and Sorcery
cards.text: Draw a card. If you generate 3 or more swords this turn, teleport to an adjacent space.
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: Return the lowest-value artifact from the dungeon to the artifact stack.

cards.name: Swashbuckling
cards.text: For each sword you spend this turn defeating tunnel or lair monsters, +1 skill.
cards.flavor: "Any other rapscallions in need of a proper walloping?"

cards.name: Swap Meet
cards.text: If you're in a lair or lost chamber, you may trash this card and one of your trophies to take a Market item (at no cost).
cards.flavor: "Now I have a riddle for you: what's gold and glowing, and worth a backpack?"

cards.name: Forage
cards.text: Gain 1 gold.
cards.flavor: The hardest "easy money" you'll ever make.

cards.name: Acrobatics
cards.text: If a Pit Trap room causes you to trash this card, acquire a card that costs 4 or less and put it in your hand.
cards.flavor: Sometimes you've gotta urn it.

cards.name: Spelunker
cards.text: +1 Clank!
cards.flavor: She comes fully prepared for any caving emergency. Unfortunately, all that equipment isn't exactly quiet.

cards.name: Rebel Messenger
cards.text: If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card.
cards.flavor: "These orders come straight from the Mountain King."

cards.name: Rebel Guard
cards.text: If you have another companion in your play area, draw a card.
cards.flavor: After training personally under Agnet, he has been assigned to protect the Mountain King.

cards.name: Pack Rat
cards.text: Acquire a card that costs 4 or less. If you have a backpack, put it in your hand.
cards.flavor: "Oh, I'll find room for it. I just might have to eat some of my aged gouda sooner than I'd planned."

cards.name: Negotiator
cards.text: Each market item you buy this turn costs 2 less.
cards.flavor: The retail price is only "suggested."

cards.name: Silver Arch
cards.text: USE: Teleport to any lair or lost chamber.
cards.flavor: "I'm not stepping through that thing," Thomas said archly.

cards.name: Mechanical Donkey
cards.text: TROPHY: If you are knocked out in the Depths, lose all your gold but then score your points. Worth 2, or -8 if you were knocked out in the Depths.

cards.name: Magic Kazoo
cards.text: USE: Put 6 gold on this card. TROPHY: At the start of your turn, +2 Clank! and take 2 gold from this card.
cards.flavor: The marvelous instrument everyone is buzzing about.

cards.name: Loot Chute
cards.text: USE: 2 gold, lockpick.
cards.flavor: For fun and profit!

cards.name: Heart of the Dark
cards.text: TROPHY: Whenever you take a Trophy (including this one), -2 Clank!
cards.flavor: It beats softly and steadily. But what is it pumping?

cards.name: Golden Hourglass
cards.text: TROPHY: Whenever you reshuffle your deck, +1 skill.
cards.arriveDanger: ARRIVE: Return the lowest-value artifact from the dungeon to the artifact stack.
cards.flavor: This time really IS money.

cards.name: Ape Lord Epaulets
cards.text: TROPHY: Worth 3 if you have a monkey idol or a crown. Worth 7 instead if you have both.

cards.name: Alarm
cards.text: USE: Each other player gets +1 Clank!
cards.arriveDanger: DANGER: Pull +1 cube for dragon attacks.
cards.flavor: A device built of the heaviest metals.

cards.name: Venomous Lurker
cards.text: DEFEAT: +3 gold. TROPHY: While you're in a Crystal Cave, you can't heal.
cards.flavor: Some say the best armor is made of Naga hide.

cards.name: Skeleton Herald
cards.text: DEFEAT: +1 Clank!, for each Clank! you've made this turn, +1 gold.
cards.arriveDanger: DANGER: Pull +1 cube for dragon attacks.
cards.flavor: Was a viking in life. In death, he sometimes gets confused about his instrument.

cards.name: Evil Wizard
cards.text: TROPHY: Each turn: the first time you play a Secret Tome, draw a card. The second time, +2 Clank! and trash this card.
cards.flavor: Evil is HAVING the eye of the beholder.
